description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - Strategic Development Project Act No. 04 of 1976 under Sub Section 22 (A)
categorisation: This gazette primarily deals with land matters, specifically declaring a defined area of land (with detailed lot descriptions, boundaries, and measurements) as a Licensed Zone under the Board of Investment law. The content focuses on land identification, surveying, and zoning rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
